research_insight_text_link.research_insight_description: Omada Health is developing systems described as domain specific language based applications for monitoring user movements. Using virtual point specification in domain specific language for monitoring user movements and stable point determination for monitoring user movements, these tools let mobile devices capture body motion measurements and transmit them to an expert. Together, these efforts focus on motion tracking, expert review workflows, and configurable measurement applications.

overview_description.description: Omada Health is a digital care company that offers innovative and clinically effective digital health programs to empower individuals to engage in their health and lead healthier lives. The program is personalized to meet each participant’s unique needs as they evolve, ranging from diabetes prevention, type 2 diabetes management, hypertension, behavioral health, and musculoskeletal issues. Omada combines professional health coaching, connected health devices, real-time data, and personalized feedback to deliver clinically meaningful results. The company is the largest CDC-recognized provider of the National Diabetes Prevention Program.

about_short_description.short_description: Omada Health is a digital behavioral medicine company that helps members change their mindsets to improve health and build lasting change.

product.name: Omada Platform
product.description: A cloud-based virtual care platform that coordinates digital programs, care teams, connected devices, health data, education, and behavior-change support across chronic conditions.

product.name: Omada for Prevention & Weight Health
product.description: A digital program for prediabetes prevention, weight management, and reduction of chronic-disease risk using coaching, personalized goals, connected scales, lessons, and lifestyle guidance.

product.name: Omada for Diabetes
product.description: A virtual diabetes-management program that combines coaching, diabetes-specialist support, connected glucose devices, continuous glucose monitoring for eligible members, education, and ongoing tracking.

product.name: Omada for Hypertension
product.description: A digital hypertension-management program that provides coaching, clinical specialist support, connected blood-pressure monitoring, personalized goals, and education on lifestyle factors affecting blood pressure.

product.name: Omada for Joint & Muscle Health
product.description: A digital musculoskeletal care program offering exercise-based treatment, physical-therapist visits and messaging, custom plans, connected progress tracking, and an exercise kit.

product.name: Omada GLP-1 Care
product.description: A coordinated GLP-1 support service that combines lifestyle coaching, nutrition and activity guidance, medication navigation, clinical prescribing, and ongoing care before, during, and after GLP-1 treatment.
